note: From the OpenStreetMap main API export (tools/osm-to-kit.mjs, 13 October 2026), at real scale across the line like the tracks: two side platforms about 94 m long on an embankment on the Marple line, 1.68 m outside its two tracks (platform 1, towards Manchester, is the halt's), the footbridge just beyond their north end with its steps down onto each platform, the line's bridge over the A560 Stockport Road East 25 m beyond that, the car park on the north-east side off Kennett Drive, the path and steps up from Stockport Road East by the Rising Sun, and the pub itself. Positive v is north-east, the car park's side. The view from above (docs/reference/aerial/bredbury.jpg) shows the embankment and the car park beside it. Photos (docs/reference/photos/bredbury: platform-1-west-1.jpg, waiting-room-1.jpg and building-1.jpg El Pollock 2015, platform-1-2.jpg, platform-2-1.jpg, entrance-1.jpg, street-1.jpg, area-low-bridge-1.jpg and area-carpark-1.jpg Gerald England 2013-21, overview-1.jpg Chris Morgan 2020): each platform has a modern red-brick building under a pitched grey roof (drawn hipped) with a canopy along its platform front, platform 1's a waiting room towards the middle, platform 2's longer one towards the south end (the station buildings, one each side; their places along the platforms are read from the photos); the platforms stand on concrete trestles with mesh fences; the footbridge is a green plate-girder span with stairs along the platforms (drawn as a grey deck with solid sides and flights of steps); the low bridge over Stockport Road East is drawn as the girders alongside the tracks. The car park's size is OSM's; how many spaces it holds is a guess from its area, split into the car park and the rest of it as two stages (the split is the game's). No lifts in the photos: they're the game's, beside the footbridge. The canopies beyond the buildings', the platform extensions (40 m at the south end and under the footbridge at the north), the glazed shelters, the kiosk and the coffee cart are the game's. The replacement bus stop on Stockport Road East by the Rising Sun, where the real buses stop (Stockport Road East / Bredbury Station), placed by eye; the cycle stands from memory. Departure boards on each platform and on platform 1's waiting room. Across the line at real scale since 13 October 2026 (it was 1.25 times).
